title: Theme context
summary: Share state through context, and fail loudly when the provider is missing.
prompt: Finish the theme context. `ThemeProvider` holds `theme` ("light" or "dark") and a `toggle` function. `useTheme()` returns them, and throws an Error mentioning "ThemeProvider" when called outside the provider. `ThemeToggle` and `ThemedPanel` already use the hook.
hints: Create the context with `createContext<Value | null>(null)`, so a missing provider is detectable.
In `useTheme`, read the context and `throw new Error(…)` if it is `null`.
